text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Today, it is possible to share electricity from a rooftop photovoltaic system with neighbours for collective self-consumption.", "gist": "Electricity from rooftop solar can now be shared with neighbours for collective self-consumption."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "the same principle makes sense for heating, because many home heating systems are oversized and therefore not used to full capacity.", "gist": "Sharing heat is also viable since many home heating systems are oversized and underutilized."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "By sharing the heat from your own heating system with neighbours, you can save on maintenance and heating costs.", "gist": "Sharing home heating heat with neighbours reduces maintenance and heating expenses."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "IWB (Industrielle Werke Basel)", "gist": "IWB, an energy company based in Basel, demonstrated the effectiveness of heat sharing."}]}
